title: Night Sky

serves.summary: The learner moves Earth around the Sun so a named star pattern is in the night sky, which shows that the stars we see at night change through the year as Earth orbits the Sun.

request.topic: Why the star patterns we see change through the year
request.objective: Explain why we see different star patterns at different times of the year: Earth goes around the Sun, and at night we look out the side of Earth that faces away from the Sun, so the stars on that side change as Earth moves (SCI003-04-d, connecting seasonal sky changes to Earth's orbit)

problems.ask: Move Earth so you can see the Lion at night.
problems.goal: Earth sits within 45 degrees of 12 o'clock, so the Lion lies out past Earth's dark half.
